answer: An agent cannot wander in from nowhere and claim standing: weight here accrues only along a thread of sealed grading verdicts, each one an on-chain action a fresh identity cannot backfill. To mint reputation a Sybil must actually grade across many epochs, earning only a faint echo of real history, so M clones pay M times the labor and can never share one warmed credential. The attacker cost grows linearly with the number of fakes rather than amortizing, which is exactly what keeps the attack unprofitable.
